currentFindings.jetbrainsRestoration: Five collected latest-package restart failures preserve the session, row ID and original Markdown; the restored body displays raw Markdown instead of preserving the live rendered body. verify-33 passes candidate acceptance but fails native end-to-end restoration.
currentFindings.fetchDiagnostic: The separate verify-19 follow-up completed 19/19 request receipts with passive diagnostics enabled and did not reproduce fetch failed. Baseline 17/17 and candidate 5/5 passed, but the behavioral mutant also passed 5/5; candidate acceptance remains false and the original transport cause remains unknown.
currentFindings.scope: Thinking disabled, six file tools, fixed project snapshot and request/turn/output limits. Generation runs on native hosts; all candidate execution acceptance runs in Linux offline Docker. Historical accepted files are reused and are not new latest-version runs.
currentFindings.windowsJetbrainsStartup: All three original Windows JetBrains records and independent acceptance receipts are collected and failed. The first CLI exited after a private-directory ACL traversal timeout; a later cleanup identity snapshot timeout masked that startup error. The next two samples failed with EADDRINUSE on 127.0.0.1:8082. All candidate files remain original 27-byte placeholders; no port owner is established by the archive. The test environment placed its profile outside the child os.tmpdir boundary. This layout is corrected in the next harness, with all product ACL checks retained. The actual hosted timeout is not reproduced or declared fixed.
